items.q: What makes Bella Coterie bamboo bedding different?
items.a: Our duvet covers are crafted from 100% organically grown bamboo viscose with a 400 thread count sateen weave. They're OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified, meaning every component has been tested and verified free from over 350 harmful chemicals. Most importantly, they're naturally cooling and get softer with every wash.

items.q: Will this really help me sleep cooler?
items.a: Yes. Bamboo viscose is naturally thermoregulating — it wicks moisture away from your body and releases heat instead of trapping it. Over 5,000 customers specifically mention sleeping cooler in their reviews.

items.q: What sizes and colors are available?
items.a: Available in Queen ($119.99), King ($129.99), and California King ($129.99). Choose from 9 colors including Charcoal Gray, Coastal Blue, Dune, Grey Mist, Ivory, Sea Glass, White, Champagne, and Slate Blue.
Each set includes one luxury bamboo duvet cover and two matching pillow shams. The duvet cover features button closure and interior snap-lock ties to keep your duvet insert perfectly in place.

items.q: How do I wash and care for it?
items.a: Machine wash on a gentle cycle with cold water and tumble dry on low. No special care needed. The bamboo viscose actually gets softer with each wash.

items.q: What if I don't love it?
items.a: We offer a 100-night trial. If it is not the finest sleep you have experienced, we will arrange a complimentary pickup. No questions.
Yes — free shipping on all US orders. International shipping is calculated at checkout.

items.q: Does the duvet cover come with an insert?
items.a: No, this is a duvet cover set only (cover + 2 pillow shams). It's designed to fit over your existing duvet insert. The interior ties and snap-lock system keep any insert securely in place.

footer.tagline: Sleep should be enjoyed, not endured.
